pictures.scene: Simon Marmion, A Choir of Angels - rank on rank of red-winged angels singing together with their hands lifted in the gold, Hallelujah, praise the LORD, O my soul
pictures.name: pd_marmion_engelen

pictures.scene: Jan Asselijn, Ruine aan het water in Italie - the great arches of a princely building standing broken and empty above the still water, put not your trust in princes, in mortal man who cannot save
pictures.name: pd_asselijn_ruine

pictures.scene: Domenico Fetti, Jacob's Dream - Jacob asleep on the bare ground with the ladder of angels going up into the light above him, blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God
pictures.name: pd_fetti_jakob

pictures.scene: Roelant Savery, Paradijs van de vogels - every kind of bird and beast gathered together under the trees of the first garden, the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea and everything in them
pictures.name: pd_savery_vogels

pictures.scene: Jacob Willemsz de Wet, Joseph selling grain in Egypt - the kneeling mother with her hand out and her children at her knees while the grain is brought down to them, He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry
pictures.name: pd_wet_koren

pictures.scene: Edmund Blair Leighton, The Charity of Saint Elizabeth of Hungary - the queen stooping at the doorway to put bread into the hands of the poor woman and her child, the LORD protects foreigners, He sustains the fatherless and the widow
pictures.name: pd_leighton_weduwe

pictures.scene: Pieter Jansz. Saenredam, The Interior of St Bavo's Church Haarlem - the white piers and vaults of the great church rising far above the small figures on the floor, the LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations
pictures.name: pd_saenredam_geslachten

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, The Valkhof at Nijmegen - the castle and the town standing on their green hill in the long golden evening light above the quiet river, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_halleluja

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD, O my soul.
I will praise the LORD all my life;
I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
Put not your trust in princes,
in mortal man, who cannot save.
When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground;
on that very day his plans perish.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob,
whose hope is in the LORD his God,
the Maker of heaven and earth,
the sea, and everything in them.
He remains faithful forever.
He executes justice for the oppressed
and gives food to the hungry.
The LORD sets the prisoners free,
the LORD opens the eyes of the blind,
the LORD lifts those who are weighed down,
the LORD loves the righteous.
The LORD protects foreigners;
He sustains the fatherless and the widow,
but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
The LORD reigns forever,
your God, O Zion, for all generations.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
